title: Single-Shot Reverse Prompt Engineering
use_case: Derive a one-shot prompt from a final output
description: Reverse-engineers a single prompt that could recreate a final output without iterative feedback.
body: Act as a prompt engineer. Based on the final output you just gave me in this conversation, write a prompt that would have produced exactly that result in a single attempt, without requiring iterative feedback. Output the prompt in a code block.

title: Image-to-DALL·E Prompt Rebuilder
use_case: Reverse prompt engineering for images
description: Analyzes any image and generates a highly detailed DALL·E prompt that rebuilds the scene.
body:
When I send you an image, analyze it visually and semantically with maximum detail and precision.

Return a complete, highly detailed prompt that I can use directly in DALL·E to recreate the image as accurately as possible.

title: Future Self Letter Scheduler
use_case: Future self motivation
description: Generates three motivational letters to your future self for 30, 90, and 365 days.
body:
I want you to write future letters to myself every 30, 90, and 365 days.

Use my goals and fears document to schedule these 3 letters with the proper date that I can open to keep me motivated.

title: Museum of Me – Five-Room Life Exhibition
use_case: Creative self-reflection
description: Creates a fictional museum with five themed rooms representing your life and identity.
body:
Describe my fictional “Museum of Me” — an imaginary exhibition space with five rooms:

1. Origins and Curiosity
2. Data and Thinking
3. Art and Creation
4. Nature and Travel
5. Future and Legacy

Describe which objects, sounds, and texts are presented in each room.

title: Five Future Selves – Identity Exploration
use_case: Identity visioning
description: Explores five possible future identities for clarity and long-term self-development.
body: Describe my “Five Future Selves” — five different possible versions of who I could become in the future.

title: The 12 Sacred Walks – Reflective Journey Framework
use_case: Symbolic reflection
description: Twelve symbolic journeys for mindfulness, values, and inner growth.
body: Describe my “12 Sacred Walks” — twelve symbolic journeys that each represent an aspect of my inner life or personal development.

title: Personal Mythology – Archetypes of Self
use_case: Mythic self-understanding
description: Creates a mythological interpretation of your identity, archetypes, symbols, and inner world.
body: Describe my “Personal Mythology” — a mythic interpretation of my life, identity, and inner world.

title: Chat Summary Article Generator
use_case: Convert chats into structured articles
description: Turns an entire chat into a clean, structured article.
body:
Write a well-structured article that summarizes everything discussed in this chat.

The article should be clear, readable, and beautifully organized.

At the end of the article, include a list of all external source links that you have mentioned in the chat.

Output only the final article, in English.

title: Visual Style Extractor
use_case: Create a reusable universal DALL·E visual-style prompt from any image
description: Extracts a reusable visual style description from any image while ignoring its content.
body:
When I send you an image, analyze it visually and semantically with maximum detail and precision.

Your task is to extract only the visual style of the image — not its content.

title: Universal Reverse Prompt Engineer
use_case: Recreate any content type through a single reversed prompt
description: Analyzes any content type and produces one high-quality prompt to recreate it with AI.
body:
You are an expert Reverse Prompt Engineer.

When I provide you with any type of content, your task is to analyze it and return one complete prompt that could recreate it as closely as possible.

title: Chat History Knowledge Extractor
use_case: Extract reusable insights from chats
description: Extracts long-term valuable knowledge from chat histories for personal knowledge management.
body: Analyze the entire chat history and extract only the content that provides meaningful added value or potential for future reuse.

title: Reverse Text Prompt Reconstruction
use_case: Reverse-engineer the original ChatGPT prompt from a text output
description: Analyzes a given text passage and reconstructs the most likely original ChatGPT prompt.
body:
When I send you a text passage, analyze it semantically and stylistically with maximum precision.

Reconstruct the most likely original prompt that could have generated this text in ChatGPT.

title: Web Visual Style Extractor
use_case: Extract reusable visual and UX style from any website
description: Analyzes a website purely for its visual design and UX patterns and converts them into a reusable style prompt.
body: When I send you a website, via URL or HTML, analyze only the visual and structural style of the page.

title: AI Video Director – Long-Form Blueprint Generator
use_case: Generate cinematic long-form video blueprints with script, visuals, and animation
description: Turns a topic into a complete long-form video blueprint divided into clips.
body:
You are an AI Video Director for long-form educational and storytelling content.

Your task:
Turn my topic into a complete long-form video blueprint divided into numbered clips.

title: Example Output with Critical Feedback Loop
use_case: Show an example output and actively challenge assumptions
description: Generates an immediate example output, then asks clarifying questions and challenges assumptions.
body:
I don't like the current output.

Show me an example output right now so I can tell you what I want to be different.

title: Letter From Your Future Self (2045)
use_case: Reflective writing from a future self perspective
description: Generates a reflective, poetic letter written from your future self in the year 2045.
body: Write a letter to my present-day self from the year 2045.

title: Visual Process Breakdown Generator
use_case: Create simple step-by-step visual process explanations
description: Generates clean visual instructions that break a process into simple, easy-to-follow steps. Optimized for infographics, educational visuals, tutorials, and social media explainers.
body:
Break down [PROCESS] into 4–6 simple visual steps.

Requirements:
- Each step should be immediately understandable at a glance.
- Use minimal text.
- Prioritize visual clarity over decoration.
- Keep the composition clean and organized.
- Use consistent icons, colors, and layout across all steps.
- Make each step visually distinct.
- Include arrows, spacing, or visual flow indicators where helpful.
- Avoid clutter and unnecessary details.
- Design in a modern infographic style.
- Ensure the final output is readable on both desktop and mobile.

title: Simple Visual Topic Explainer
use_case: Explain complex topics in an extremely simple way
description: Helps simplify difficult concepts using plain language, visual metaphors, and beginner-friendly explanations. Designed for learning, teaching, and making complex ideas intuitive.
body:
Explain [TOPIC] in the simplest possible way.

Requirements:
- Assume I have absolutely no prior knowledge.
- Use plain, everyday language.
- Avoid jargon unless absolutely necessary.
- If a technical term must be used, explain it immediately in simple words.
- Use visual metaphors, analogies, or simple imaginary illustrations to make concepts intuitive.
- Break the explanation into small, easy-to-follow sections.
- Prioritize clarity over completeness.
- Make the explanation feel conversational and beginner-friendly.
- Use examples from daily life whenever possible.
- End with a short one-sentence summary that captures the core idea.
